{{Short description|none}} {{Use mdy dates|date=January 2025}} This is a list of [[National Football League]] (NFL) players by total career [[rush (American football)#Offense|rushing]] [[touchdown]]s. This list includes all players with at least 75. [[Emmitt Smith]] is the all-time leader with 164. He also leads in postseason touchdowns with 19. [[Cam Newton]] and [[Josh Allen]] are the only [[quarterback]]s on this list; the rest are [[running back]]s. ==Players with at least 75 touchdowns== [[File:EmmittSmith2007 (crop).jpg|thumb|[[Emmitt Smith]] has the most rushing touchdowns with 164.]] {| class="wikitable" |+ Key | style="text-align:center; background:#ffb;"|^ | Inducted into the [[Pro Football Hall of Fame]] |- | style="text-align:center; background:#cfecec;"|* | Denotes player who is still active |} ''Through Week 10 of the {{NFL year|2026}} season'' {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align:center;" |- !Rank !Player !Team(s) by season !Touchdowns |- |1 |style="background:#ffb;"|[[Emmitt Smith]]^ |[[Dallas Cowboys]] ([[1990 NFL season|1990]]–[[2002 NFL season|2002]])
